models.name: metrics
models.sql:
WITH completed_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
),
order_payments AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS order_revenue_cents
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
completed_revenue AS (
  SELECT co.customer_id, co.order_id, co.order_date,
         COALESCE(op.order_revenue_cents, 0) AS order_revenue_cents
  FROM completed_orders co
  LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON co.order_id = op.order_id
),
customer_grain AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(cr.order_revenue_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents,
         COUNT(cr.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN completed_revenue cr ON c.customer_id = cr.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime(CAST(order_date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS period
  FROM orders
),
customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.period
  FROM customers c CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT cr.customer_id,
         strftime(CAST(cr.order_date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS period,
         SUM(cr.order_revenue_cents) AS revenue_cents,
         COUNT(cr.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM completed_revenue cr
  GROUP BY cr.customer_id, strftime(CAST(cr.order_date AS DATE), '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT cm.customer_id,
       cm.period,
       COALESCE(mr.revenue_cents, 0) AS revenue_cents,
       COALESCE(mr.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM customer_months cm
LEFT JOIN monthly_revenue mr ON cm.customer_id = mr.customer_id AND cm.period = mr.period
UNION ALL
SELECT cg.customer_id, NULL AS period, cg.revenue_cents, cg.order_count
FROM customer_grain cg
